rules.statement: The declarations of the testatrix regarding her intentions to bequeath all her property to her child are admissible in evidence under Section 14 of the Evidence Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: "It has been argued that statements of deceased persons can only be proved under section 32 of the Ordinance the provisions of which are, inapplicable in the present case. Illustration (m) to section 14 appears to me to be an answer to this. 'The question is, what was the state of A's health at the time when an insurance on his life was effected. Statements made by A as to the state of his health at or near the time in question are relevant facts'. This illustration follows English Law."
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 14 of the Evidence Ordinance, Illustration (m)
